title: Household Pet Rate Table — Community Rules & Site Care
content:
The registration-year rate of each pet on a Community Rules & Site Care plan record is set by the household's registered pets and the home section recorded on the Home-Site Lease.

| Registered pets on the plan record | Home on the site, per the Home-Site Lease | Household pet rate, per pet per registration year |
|---|---|---|
| reached the pet limit of 2 (2 or more) | single-section | $40.00 |
| reached the pet limit of 2 (2 or more) | multi-section | $35.00 |
| fewer than 2 | single-section or multi-section | the plan's annual pet registration fee |

The pet limit is 2 on every plan, and the registered pets have reached it when the registered pet count on the plan record is 2 or more.

## The threshold on both sides

- 1 registered pet: fewer than the limit, so the rate is the plan's annual pet registration fee, whatever the home section.
- 2 registered pets: the limit is reached, so the rate is $40.00 on a single-section home site and $35.00 on a multi-section home site.

## Hypothetical cases

| Household | Rate for each pet's registration year |
|---|---|
| two dogs, single-section home | $40.00 |
| a dog and a cat, multi-section home | $35.00 |
| one cat, multi-section home | the plan's annual pet registration fee |
